LanguageData.PS_RoleDirectorDesc: Experience the game from an omniscient point of view, only managing the characters. The classic experience.
LanguageData.PS_RoleCharacterDesc: Experience the game from the point of view of one or many of your characters. Customizable.
LanguageData.PS_ShowControlsOnFirstInhabit: Show controls on first ever inhabit
LanguageData.PS_ShowControlsOnFirstInhabitDesc: The first time you take control of a character in a save, open a summary of the character controls. Turning this off hides it everywhere, including in saves that have not shown it yet.
LanguageData.PS_InhabitedControlsRebindWarning: If you have rebound your keys, these may no longer apply. This will only show once per save.
LanguageData.PS_ControlLeftClick: Begin hauling an item, or otherwise operate it
LanguageData.PS_ControlLeftClickHold: Specific tasks like building, mining, or chopping
LanguageData.PS_ControlRightClick: Queue more advanced jobs on things
LanguageData.PS_ControlStoreItem: Store the carried item in your inventory
LanguageData.PS_ModeAuthenticDesc: You must stick with the character you choose forever. You may never switch to omniscient view, and are always in your character's shoes.\n\nRecommended for narrative experiences.
LanguageData.PS_ModeSwapDesc: You may switch between characters, but must always remain in the perspective of the characters.\n\nRecommended for players who like the playstyle but want more control over multiple characters.
LanguageData.PS_ModeDynamicDesc: While your primary form of play will be within your characters, you may swap between director style play or playing as any of your characters at any point.\n\nRecommended for players who want the flexibility of all perspective playstyles.
LanguageData.PS_DisableAimingDelay: Disable aiming time for player character
LanguageData.PS_DisableAimingDelayDesc: When checked, your controlled character fires weapons instantly without having to wait for the weapon's aiming cycle. Cooldown between shots still applies.
LanguageData.PS_EnableDamageScreenEffectDesc: Flashes a red overlay on the screen briefly when your controlled character takes damage.
LanguageData.PS_SleepingPreventsVisionDesc: While the character you are inhabiting is asleep or unconscious, the world fades to black until they wake up. Your interface stays visible.
LanguageData.PS_DisallowOtherMapsInAuthentic: Disallow seeing other maps in authentic style
LanguageData.PS_DisallowOtherMapsInAuthenticDesc: In authentic style you can only look at the map your character is on. Jumping to another colony, to a pawn elsewhere, or to a letter about another map is refused, including while your character is travelling in a caravan.
LanguageData.PS_CannotViewOtherMaps: You can only see where your character is.
LanguageData.PS_WeaponTooltipsDesc: Hovering a weapon within reach shows its name, quality, and how its DPS and armor penetration compare with what you have equipped.
LanguageData.PS_ApparelTooltipsDesc: Hovering apparel within reach shows its name, quality, and how its armor and insulation compare with whatever it would replace.
LanguageData.PS_HaulingCursorDesc: While you are carrying something, the cursor becomes a drop marker, replacing the aiming reticle even while drafted.
LanguageData.PS_EatTooltipsDesc: Hovering food within reach shows a hint over it reminding you that double-clicking eats it.
LanguageData.PS_HarvestTooltipsDesc: Hovering a harvestable plant within reach shows what it yields and that yield's nutrition.
LanguageData.PS_RotateCornerTip: Move the interface to the next corner.
LanguageData.PS_ScaleInterfaceTip: Drag to resize the needs and gizmos. Right-click to reset to normal size.
LanguageData.PS_TotalFreedomDesc: Always allow character switching regardless of any settings.
LanguageData.PS_AllowNonHumanDesc: Allows possessing animals, mechanoids, and other non-colonist pawns.
LanguageData.PS_RequirePawnInFaction: Require target to be in faction
LanguageData.PS_RequirePawnInFactionDesc: Ensures you can only take control of pawns that are part of your faction. Disable carefully, this is unsupported and only meant for fooling around.
LanguageData.PS_DisableCustomGizmosDesc: Disables the custom Perspective Shift gizmo overlay. You will need to manually click/select your character to see their gizmos, just like in vanilla RimWorld.
LanguageData.PS_MustSelectCharacter: You must select a character before continuing.
LanguageData.PS_StorageNotPermitted: You are trying to place {0} into {1}, but it is not permitted to be stored there in it's storage settings. Would you like to enable storing this item?\n\nNote: This will let other colonists store this item here too.
LanguageData.PS_CannotCarryMoreWeight: You cannot carry any more weight. Consider dropping some items.
LanguageData.PS_BlueprintFull: This blueprint has all materials necessary to build.
LanguageData.PS_StorageDoesNotAccept: Storage does not accept this item.
LanguageData.PS_RomanceAdvanceTitle: {0} is making a romantic advance on you.
LanguageData.PS_MarriageProposalTitle: {0} is asking for your hand in marriage.
LanguageData.PS_GoWithYourGut_Desc: Leave it up to the numbers, what this character would do if not under your control.
LanguageData.PS_PermadeathDesc: With this toggle enabled, for the duration of this run you will not be able to swap to any other pawns or back to director mode to continue your run after you die. You are your only hope.\n\nRecommended only for players willing to lose everything, there is no going back after using this toggle.
LanguageData.PS_AllowSwitchingToDirectorModeDesc: With this toggle enabled, for the duration of this run you may switch to director mode whenever you'd like. However, you are still forced to embody only one colonist and to protect their life.\n\nRecommended for players who want to embody a specific character, but would like to optionally keep the original gameplay fully intact.
LanguageData.PS_SeekAtWillDesc: Automatically seek and attack enemies within range. Not available while drafted.
LanguageData.PS_SeekAtWillDraftedReason: Seek at will is not available while drafted. Draft mode is for manual control only.
LanguageData.PS_InhabitNewCharacter_Desc: Play as somebody else in your game. This will send you back into director mode, where you can click a new character and choose to permanently embody them.
LanguageData.PS_ContinueDynamicMode_Desc: Continue your game in total freedom, where you can swap between any of your characters or director mode at will.
LanguageData.PS_ContinueSwapMode_Desc: Continue your game from the perspective of your characters, freely swapping between them.
LanguageData.PS_ContinueDirectorMode_Desc: Continue your game from an omniscient point of view, directing and managing your characters.
LanguageData.PS_StorageFull: {0} cannot be deposited as the storage is full.
LanguageData.PS_BedForPrisonersOnly: This bed is for prisoners only.
LanguageData.PS_BedForSlavesOnly: This bed is for slaves only.
LanguageData.PS_BedForColonistsOnly: This bed is for colonists only.
LanguageData.PS_HoldToFireDesc: Holding the left mouse button while drafted will continuously fire your weapon without disabling cooldowns.
LanguageData.PS_CameraEasingDesc: Smoothly interpolates the camera toward your character. Disable if you experience motion sickness.
LanguageData.PS_RequireHeldClickForJobs: Require held click for some jobs (cut, mine, etc)
LanguageData.PS_RequireHeldClickForJobsDesc: You must hold the left mouse button to continue jobs like mining or harvesting. Disable for accessibility.
LanguageData.PS_DisableDoubleClickEquipDesc: Double-clicking a destination while carrying a weapon or apparel will no longer wear or equip it instead of dropping it.
LanguageData.PS_DisableDoubleClickEatDesc: Double-clicking a destination while carrying food will no longer eat it instead of dropping it.
LanguageData.PS_NeedRanOut_Mood: You are having a mental break.
LanguageData.PS_CannotDropOnBlueprint: Cannot drop here: blueprint does not need this material.
LanguageData.PS_LostToFaction: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer under your control.
LanguageData.PS_CannotSprintExhausted: You are too exhausted to sprint.
LanguageData.PS_HoldingPlatformOccupied: This holding platform is already occupied.
LanguageData.PS_CannotCaptureEntity: This entity cannot be captured to a holding platform.
LanguageData.PS_MineCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor to a pickaxe when hovering over rock or a wall your character could mine.
LanguageData.PS_ResetAllConfirm: Reset every Perspective Shift setting back to its default value?
LanguageData.PS_BuildCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor to a hammer when hovering over a construction frame that has all of its materials.
LanguageData.PS_ChopCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor to an axe when hovering over a tree your character could chop.
LanguageData.PS_HarvestCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor to a sickle when hovering over a plant your character could harvest.
LanguageData.PS_SleepCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor when hovering over a bed your character could sleep in. Hidden while you are already resting.
LanguageData.PS_ResearchCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor when hovering over a research bench your character could work at. Hidden while you are already researching.
LanguageData.PS_RoofCursorDesc: Swaps the cursor when hovering over a cell marked for roofing that your character could roof.
LanguageData.PS_FishingMinigameDesc: Replaces fishing zones with a hands-on minigame. Right-click any fishable water as your character to cast a line, wait for a bite, then reel it in. While this is on, the inhabited pawn no longer can automatically fish.
LanguageData.PS_FishingEscapedMessage: The catch slipped off the line.
